Restaurants Around Hutan Pinus Pengger

Pinus Pengger sits in the Dlingo corridor, not a dense dining district. This page helps understand dining options nearby, approximate distance and how to get back.

Dining-choice pattern

Options are generally simple warung around the site or along Dlingo–Patuk, not rows of large restaurants. Choose by your travel route.

Detail

Distance and access

  • Distances are approximate; hill roads can extend travel time.

Detail

Getting back

Note the restaurant position, keep the phone charged, and agree on a return ride before dark.

Do not rely on one restaurant; have a backup if it is closed.

Frequently asked questions

Are there restaurants near Pinus Pengger?

Options are generally simple warung around the site or Dlingo corridor. This guide recommends no specific business.

How far is the nearest restaurant?

Distance is approximate and depends on the hill route. Ask staff about warung that are open.

Is reservation needed?

Small warung usually no, but this guide does not verify. Ask the provider directly.

What if the restaurant is closed?

Have a backup; bring snacks or eat in the city before/after the visit.
